newsitem.title: USA: Perry to visit Panama and Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Perry to visit Panama and Argentina.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry leaves on Saturday for Panama and Argentina, where he will attend a meeting on regional security with Latin American ministers, the Defence Department said on Monday.
Perry will first be briefed on U.S. Southern Command operations in Panama and meet with U.S. military officials there, the department said.
In Argentina, he will attend the second Defence Ministerial of the Americas at San Carlos de Bariloche to discuss Caribbean and Latin American security issues with defence ministers from the region.
The first meeting was held last year in Williamsburg, Virginia.
